title: Prompt schema and template contract for LLM appraisal
objective: Define the data schema and rendering contract that converts an AppraisalInput into a structured LLM prompt, and specify how an LLM text response is parsed back into a validated AppraisalOutput. No live LLM call path; schema and template only.
exact_scope: Create two new modules: (1) back/app/llm/prompt_schema.py defining PromptTemplate and LlmAppraisalRequest as Pydantic models that capture the rendered prompt text plus all metadata needed to reconstruct context; (2) back/app/llm/response_parser.py containing a pure-function parser that accepts an LLM text response string and returns an AppraisalOutput or raises a structured ParseError. Create back/app/llm/__init__.py to make the package importable. Write tests in back/tests/test_p30_t1_prompt_schema.py covering prompt rendering correctness and response parsing. No engine wiring, no HTTP calls, no changes to existing files.
constraints: AppraisalSignal v1 is frozen — do not modify appraisal_settlement.py or any existing contract field
AppraisalOutput schema is frozen — do not add, remove, or rename fields on AppraisalOutput
AppraisalInput schema is frozen — do not modify appraisal_input.py
No live LLM call path may be created in this task — this is schema and template definition only
The prompt template must be deterministic — given the same AppraisalInput, it must always produce the same prompt text
The response parser must return a valid AppraisalOutput (passing all existing AppraisalOutput validators) or raise a clearly typed ParseError
The response parser must not write to any state model directly — it returns a value only
Deferred ticks T3/T5/T6/T7/T8 must be representable in the prompt schema even though they are not in scope for live appraisal
All enum values used in prompt rendering must be sourced from existing domain enums — no new string literals duplicating enum values
No new dependencies beyond the Python standard library and packages already in the project
acceptance_criteria: A PromptTemplate model exists in back/app/llm/prompt_schema.py and holds the system prompt string and one or more user prompt section templates as string fields

A LlmAppraisalRequest model exists in back/app/llm/prompt_schema.py and is constructable from any valid AppraisalInput via a factory function or classmethod; the rendered text fields are deterministic

The rendered user prompt includes: tick_type, world_day, agent_id, all AgentContextSlice fields, all WorldContextSlice fields, relational_context fields when present (None otherwise), social_event_context fields when present, player_context fields when present

The rendered prompt includes a clearly delimited output format section that specifies exactly which fields the LLM must return and in which format (JSON block with field names matching AppraisalOutput contract-bearing fields)
A ParseError exception class exists in back/app/llm/response_parser.py with at least a reason string field
A parse_llm_response function exists in back/app/llm/response_parser.py accepting a raw string and returning AppraisalOutput
parse_llm_response raises ParseError for inputs that are not valid JSON, missing required contract-bearing fields, or contain values that violate AppraisalOutput validators
parse_llm_response sets fallback_used=False and preserves confidence if present in the LLM response
All tests in back/tests/test_p30_t1_prompt_schema.py pass with the existing test suite (no regressions)
required_tests: Given a T1 (information_exposure) AppraisalInput, building a LlmAppraisalRequest succeeds and the rendered user prompt contains the headline, trending_topic, and tick_type label
Given a T2 (social_interaction) AppraisalInput, the rendered prompt contains relational_context fields (target_name, trust, closeness)
Given a T4 (relationship_shift) AppraisalInput with a social_event_context, the rendered prompt contains social event fields (event_type, intensity)
Given a deferred-tick AppraisalInput (e.g. T5 emotional_shift), building a LlmAppraisalRequest does not raise an error and produces a prompt that clearly marks the tick as deferred
The rendered user prompt always contains a clearly delimited output format section listing the contract-bearing output fields
parse_llm_response with a well-formed JSON string matching all required contract-bearing fields returns a valid AppraisalOutput with fallback_used=False
parse_llm_response with absorption=none and aftershock_days=1 raises ParseError (AppraisalOutput validator violation)
parse_llm_response with a JSON string that is missing the absorption field raises ParseError
parse_llm_response with a non-JSON string raises ParseError
parse_llm_response with absorption=deep, valid valence, arousal, and a growth list containing a duplicate dimension raises ParseError
non_goals: Making any actual HTTP or API call to an LLM service
Wiring the prompt or parser into the day_simulator or any live execution path
Defining a shadow-run comparison harness (that is a later P30 task)
Adding new fields to AppraisalInput or AppraisalOutput
Handling prompt caching, token counting, or cost estimation
